selection: Use the frozen parent's original 216 public training games only for fitting. Exclude registrations SHA256(late-rival-1|name) modulo 4 equal to zero, select at most 48 by SHA256(late-actor-1|id), prioritizing every loss before the remaining candidates. Fresh full scored Master6 appearances from appendices 97de1ebc,2cc7c358,b5e6a7f8,aca9b8a3 all form the development holdout; do not filter on win or loss. Verify game, seed and terrain disjoint from every training map of the frozen actor. Original conditionally frozen developer corpus, not an independent formal exam.
target: For the demonstrated collector, count only brand-new mining by that same worker on decisions t..min(t+3,T-1), when its post-tax portion actually reached its OWN base before terminal while remaining with the original worker. Other workers' receipts, friendly relays, collision spoils, old cargo, ground returns and terminal cargo are not added. Four-turn blocks never overlap for any root in the same game. Late=pre_t>=225. Immediately moving may set up new work in the next three steps. Log old principal settlement, lifetime costs and controls separately.
baseline: Ridge prediction of log1p(target) uses only public pre-action state of the worker and rivals, never the demonstrated command or a future event. Four map-hash folds; each training label uses an out-of-fold baseline trained without that entire map. Fit held estimates using training only. Map-equal and action-blind standardization. Clip log-target residual / 2 into [-0.7,0.7] and exponentiate. No target-based sample removal.
fit: Matched unweighted actor vs advantage-weighted actor, same Sapling parent, minibatches and selected roots, seed 658613. Finetune only existing decoder heads whead, U and V; encoder, recurrent state and value heads frozen. 48 updates, batch 16 roots, AdamW lr 0.00016. Training-only confidence, no early stopping. On target collectors use normalized weighted recorded-action CE (0.55) and parent KL (0.45). Other active roles/periods receive parent KL. Export both actors in full standard NPZ.
gate: Fixed held-map average candidate minus unweighted weighted-target NLL <0, unweighted collector CE degradation <=0.01, full-prefix legal worker command differs from unweighted on at least 0.5% of evaluated late collector slots, early/base/planter free-decoding change <=2% vs unweighted; test weighted-label signal is merely behavioral and no new original match is authorized by these results alone. Require an independent root response before native promotion.
isolation: No fresh native worker or formal-map seed is used. Actions the teacher did not choose have no observed terminal supervision. Settled fresh labels and on-replay association are not causal action returns.
